text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا ٱلْحِسَابُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a fresh conditional continuation from the prior divine-record frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the discourse before the conditional begins. It makes the ayah a new movement, but one still carried forward from the prior frame of divine control and record.

topics.headline: resumptive opening scopes the conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the conditional future as a continued divine-control argument, not as an isolated new topic.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the conditional unit and locally functions as discourse resumption rather than simple item coordination.

words.gloss_range: reinforced conditional particle governing both alternatives and one shared answer
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) opens a conditional frame that covers both the showing branch and the taking branch. With the following intensifier and the energetic verbs, the uncertainty is not whether the final role boundary holds, but which divine act the Prophet may experience.

topics.headline: one condition governs two alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that both possible futures are grammatically subordinated to the same limited-duty answer.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes words 2 through 9 the protasis and word 10 the apodosis marker, so both alternatives feed one answer.

topics.headline: reinforced whether-even-if force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is emphatic and concessive in feel, not a weak speculation.
topics.reason: The local sequence combines the conditional particle, following intensifier, and energetic marking on the branch verbs.

topics.headline: decree narrows into prophetic experience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from absolute divine control to what the Prophet may or may not witness within that control.
topics.reason: The conditional particle begins the Prophet-facing mission frame after the prior divine-control discourse.

words.gloss_range: semantically light intensifier after the conditional particle, not a relative pronoun or negator

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conditional particle reinforced by this intensifier

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) does not introduce a new object or negation here. Its position after {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) makes it reinforce the conditional frame, so the clause gains pressure without adding another thing to be seen.

topics.headline: light particle reinforces the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reading the particle as what or not and instead hears it tightening the conditional force.
topics.reason: The word is marked locally as an intensifier following the conditional particle, and the following energetic verb confirms the reinforced frame.

words.gloss_range: emphatic causative showing or making-perceptible, with the Prophet bound as recipient and the shown content made partial by the following object
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, judging, showing, and visionary disclosure; local Form IV selects caused perception or display

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: partitive object that makes the disclosure selective

words.prose: {{ar:نُرِيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:nuriyannaka}}) makes the first branch an emphatic divine act of causing the Prophet to see. The root can range across sight, perception, and envisioning, but the local Form IV narrows it to caused disclosure, and the following {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}) makes that disclosure selective rather than total, a presented proof from a larger promised whole. Its -ka suffix also matches the later taking verb, so the Prophet remains the affected recipient in both alternatives, while the later restriction keeps these heavy verbs from defining his duty.

topics.headline: caused disclosure, not simple seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the event is something God makes the Prophet perceive, not perception initiated or controlled by the Prophet.
topics.reason: The broad seeing root is locally narrowed by Form IV causative morphology and first-person plural subject agreement; physical and visionary modes remain possible only within caused disclosure.

topics.headline: showing exposes only a portion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine showing functions as evidence-presentation from a larger promised whole, not full unveiling.
topics.reason: The verb governs both the addressee suffix and the explicit partitive object that follows.

topics.headline: shown or taken, the same addressee is acted upon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two branches as balanced alternatives because both carry emphatic verbal weight and the same addressed recipient.
topics.reason: The matched suffix and energetic marking bind this verb to the later taking branch, with parallel reassurance formulas also attested at 10:46 and 40:77.

topics.headline: direct address surfaces in the suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from a broad divine-control frame into direct address, while the final restriction prevents the heavy verbs from defining the Prophet's duty.
topics.reason: The bound second-person suffix marks the Prophet as addressee, and the later restrictive apodosis limits the role consequence of either emphatic branch.

words.gloss_range: accusative partitive object: a portion, sample, or subset from the promised matter
words.root_gloss_range: part, portion, subset, division, and partiality; local syntax selects the shown portion of a larger promised whole
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}) is the explicit object of the showing verb, so what is displayed is partial from the start. The following relative clause specifies the domain as the promised matter, while the word order lets partiality arrive before the content is named. The portion functions like a sample-preview from a larger unrevealed outcome and belongs to the same showing-taking reassurance field seen at 10:46 and 40:77.

topics.headline: the shown content is explicitly partial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine disclosure is grammatically limited to a portion, leaving the larger promised whole still present.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the explicit object of the showing verb and carries partitive sense.

topics.headline: relative phrase defines portion of what
topics.reader_payoff: The reader receives limitation first, then learns that the limited portion belongs to the promised threat-content.
topics.reason: The partitive noun is bound to the following relative phrase, which supplies the domain of selection.

topics.headline: sample-preview from a larger field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word's preview effect: a disclosed sample points beyond itself to a larger unrevealed remainder.
topics.reason: Lexical and local same-surah evidence support part, sample, and partition force without making the whole visible.

topics.headline: partiality belongs to the showing-taking formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the portion shown and the alternative taking are not separate motifs but parts of the same repeated reassurance field.
topics.reason: The supplied pair evidence connects the partitive field with the taking branch in parallels at 10:46 and 40:77.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun binding the partitive noun to the promise clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: partitive noun specified by the relative clause

words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِي}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) turns the following promise verb into the specification of {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}). The promised matter remains abstract as that-which, but it is no longer free-floating; it becomes the domain from which the shown portion is selected.

topics.headline: relative pronoun binds portion to promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase is a nested object: portion first, promised content second.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the clause that modifies and specifies the partitive object.

words.gloss_range: promise or threat directed to them, with bundle-root pressure from counting and preparation kept as a qualified undertone
words.root_gloss_range: bundle root gives counting and preparing; surface sense locally functions as promising or threatening the addressed opponents
words.prose: {{ar:نَعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:naʿiduhum}}) supplies the content-domain for the portion shown: what is promised or threatened to them. The -hum suffix keeps the opponents bound into the verb, while the bundle's {{ar:ع د د}} ({{tr:ʿ-d-d}}) root evidence lets the promise carry prepared-and-counted pressure without replacing the local promise/threat sense. That prepared threat-content stands inside the repeated showing-taking formula at 10:46 and 40:77 and moves toward the final accounting, with the prior record-frame making the outcome feel held rather than free-floating.

topics.headline: the promised matter is directed to them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat-content has a bound target group, not an unspecified future event.
topics.reason: The verb carries a third-person plural object suffix and the referent evidence routes it to the opposing group.

topics.headline: promise sense carries count-preparation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pledged outcome feels prepared and counted, while the local verb still reads as promise or threat.
topics.reason: The input marks {{ar:ع د د}} ({{tr:ʿ-d-d}}), but the surface gloss and local relative clause support promise/threat as the selected sense; count/preparation remains a qualified pressure.

topics.headline: promised content moves toward reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promised threat-content and final accounting as one arc from prepared outcome to settled evaluation.
topics.reason: The same showing-taking reassurance pattern appears at 10:46 and 40:77, and the local ending assigns the reckoning stage to God.

topics.headline: prior record frame grounds the threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised outcome is framed as held within divine record and aimed at a definite group.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence connects the prior record-frame to this verb's bound third-plural target.

words.gloss_range: exclusive disjunction between two protasis branches
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) pivots from the Prophet being shown part of the promised matter to the Prophet being taken. The particle keeps the branches alternative rather than cumulative, while the same final answer applies to either branch.

topics.headline: or separates witnessing from being taken
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hinge from one possible prophetic experience to another without expanding the Prophet's duty.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second branch with the first inside one conditional protasis.

words.gloss_range: emphatic divine taking in full, locally the second conditional alternative and not merely bare death vocabulary
words.root_gloss_range: completion, fulfillment, taking in full, and death by divine taking; local Form V selects complete taking of the addressed Prophet
words.prose: {{ar:نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ}} ({{tr:natawaffayannaka}}) balances the first branch with the same emphatic weight and the same -ka recipient. Its {{ar:و ف ي}} ({{tr:w-f-y}}) family frames the branch as complete divine taking or fulfillment of a term, while the apodosis keeps even this endpoint from becoming the ayah's final point. The branch also belongs to the repeated prophetic reassurance formula at 10:46 and 40:77; broader usage such as 3:55 stays comparative and does not control the local branch.

topics.headline: complete divine taking, not bare death wording
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second branch sounds like God taking fully and completing a term, not simply a neutral death notice.
topics.reason: The local Form V taking verb selects complete divine taking; broader fulfillment senses color the branch but do not replace the local endpoint.

topics.headline: second branch matches the first in weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears showing and taking as balanced divine alternatives because both carry heavy form and the same addressed object.
topics.reason: The second verb repeats the energetic profile and the second-person object suffix after the disjunction.

topics.headline: fulfillment language meets obligation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taking branch stands beside obligation language, making the endpoint feel like a completed trust.
topics.reason: The root family includes fulfillment, and the apodosis uses duty-bearing prepositional clauses.

topics.headline: recognized prophetic reassurance branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this taking branch belongs to a repeated reassurance formula at 10:46 and 40:77, while broader usage such as 3:55 remains comparative rather than controlling.
topics.reason: The cross-reference parallels support the formulaic branch; the 3:55 comparison only cautions against forcing biological death into every use of the root.

topics.headline: taking branch closes before the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the complete taking branch is not the conclusion; the answer comes only after it.
topics.reason: The second branch ends immediately before the apodosis marker.

words.gloss_range: apodosis marker turning the two alternatives into one consequent role statement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from the two verbal alternatives to the single answer. It does not merely mean next; it marks the role-limiting clause as the consequence of either branch.

topics.headline: condition resolves into one answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exact turn where uncertainty gives way to a fixed responsibility statement.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis after the dual protasis and therefore controls the conditional consequence.

topics.headline: answer is restriction, not timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consequence is not a new event but a narrowed distribution of responsibility.
topics.reason: The apodosis marker is immediately followed by the restriction particle and then by mirrored nominal responsibility clauses.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle limiting what is upon the Prophet to conveyance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted upon-you predicate in the restricted duty clause
mirrored upon-Us predicate in the divine reckoning clause
opening conditional particle echoed by the restriction
opening intensifier echoed in the restriction particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) turns the apodosis into restriction: only the conveyance is placed on the Prophet. Because the particle lands before {{ar:عَلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿalayka}}) and before the duty noun, exclusivity reaches the bearer phrase before the task is named, then joins the mirrored {{ar:عَلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿalayka}}) / {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) split. Its echo of the opening {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) plus {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) lets the reinforced condition answer itself with reinforced limitation.

topics.headline: restriction excludes roles beyond conveyance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that acceptance, timing, and reckoning are excluded from the Prophet's burden by the particle itself.
topics.reason: The word is marked as a restrictive particle governing the following responsibility clause.

topics.headline: fused particle creates scope narrowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusivity lands before the bearer phrase and before the duty noun is named.
topics.reason: The fused particle precedes the fronted predicate and confines the first clause before the coordinated divine clause expands the role pair.

topics.headline: opening condition echoes in the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the formal return from reinforced condition to reinforced restriction.
topics.reason: The particle material of the opening condition returns in compressed form at the answer.

topics.headline: restriction joins the mirrored role split
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees restriction, fronting, and mirrored prepositions working together to create a stronger role boundary.
topics.reason: The restriction particle combines with the following fronted predicate and the later mirrored divine predicate.

words.gloss_range: fronted prepositional predicate marking a bounded duty upon the addressed Prophet

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: mirrored upon-Us predicate that answers the upon-you frame

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿalayka}}) puts the bearer before the duty noun: upon you, then the conveyance. The preposition and suffix compact the duty directly onto the addressed Prophet, applying the prior divine-control frame to his limited commission. The same prepositional shape returns in {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}), so the ayah distributes two responsibilities by changing only the pronoun in a mirrored frame.

topics.headline: fronted upon-you marks limited burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is named as duty-bearer before the duty itself is named.
topics.reason: The phrase is the fronted predicate before the delayed subject and carries obligation force in context.

topics.headline: preposition and suffix compact the role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duty is attached directly to the upon relation, sharpening both bearer and limit.
topics.reason: The preposition fuses with the second-person suffix, and the restriction particle before it narrows the clause.

topics.headline: you and Us divide the responsibilities
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact role map: conveyance on the Prophet's side and reckoning on God's side.
topics.reason: The same prepositional-predicate frame recurs in the following clause with the pronoun shifted.

topics.headline: divine-control frame becomes addressed commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior divine-control discourse being applied directly to the Prophet's limited commission.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence tracks the shift from divine axiom to addressed role assignment.

words.gloss_range: the definite abstract conveyance or message-reaching duty, not guaranteed acceptance or reckoning
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, conveying, and eloquent effectiveness; local noun names the bounded communicative duty

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired reckoning noun assigned to the divine speaker

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَلَٰغُ}} ({{tr:al-balāghu}}) names the known duty that rests on the Prophet after the restrictive particle. Its {{ar:ب ل غ}} ({{tr:b-l-gh}}) root makes the task message-reaching rather than controlling response, and the mirrored pairing with {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābu}}) separates transmission from evaluation. The conveyance formula is sharpened here by restriction, and the same-surah reaching thread moves from earlier reaching language at 13:14 into this completed communicative duty, with 13:18 marking reckoning as a separate threat-field.

topics.headline: definite delayed noun names the known duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duty is identifiable and bounded, placed after the upon-you predicate inside restriction.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, nominative, and delayed after the fronted predicate in the restricted apodosis.

topics.headline: conveyance reaches; acceptance is not guaranteed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet's task is effective transmission of the message, not ownership of the audience's response.
topics.reason: The root's reaching/conveying field is selected by the abstract noun, while the following reckoning clause assigns outcome evaluation elsewhere.

topics.headline: conveyance pairs with reckoning as a role boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as a two-stage handoff: message reaching on one side, accounting on the other.
topics.reason: The first nominal responsibility clause is complete before the conjunction, and the paired abstract nouns occupy mirrored slots.

topics.headline: local and formulaic reaching echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this known conveyance formula is locally sharpened by restriction and by the same-surah movement from reaching language at 13:14 to duty here.
topics.reason: The evidence supports formulaic messenger-responsibility usage and same-surah reaching links, while 13:18 helps contrast reckoning as a separate divine claim.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the second nominal responsibility clause to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second responsibility clause with the first. Unlike the opening resumptive connector, this one works inside the apodosis to hold the two assignments in parallel rather than making the reckoning clause a restart.

topics.headline: and links the mirrored assignments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two role clauses are coordinated as a balanced pair, not stacked as unrelated statements.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the second nominal assertion with the preceding apodosis clause.

topics.headline: same particle, changed scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated connector frame the ayah externally and internally while shifting function.
topics.reason: The opening connector resumes discourse, whereas this connector coordinates within the apodosis.

words.gloss_range: fronted upon-Us predicate assigning reckoning to the divine speaker in the same frame used for the Prophet's duty
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) repeats the upon-preposition frame, but shifts the suffix from you to Us. That mirroring makes reckoning a divine self-assumed responsibility, with the bearer named before the reckoning noun just as the Prophet was named before conveyance. The prior record-frame now becomes a responsibility claim: what is in divine custody is upon the divine speaker to reckon.

topics.headline: upon-Us mirrors upon-you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the responsibility transfer through the same prepositional shape with only the suffix changed.
topics.reason: The phrase uses the same prepositional-predicate pattern as the prior clause while shifting to first-person plural.

topics.headline: reckoning is placed upon Us
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reckoning is not just predicted as something God will do; it is framed as God's own assumed responsibility.
topics.reason: The fronted predicate governs the delayed reckoning noun and uses the obligation frame for the divine speaker.

topics.headline: record custody becomes reckoning responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior record-frame continuing into a claim of divine responsibility for reckoning.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence connects divine custody of the record to the clause that puts accounting upon the divine speaker.

words.gloss_range: the definite abstract reckoning, accounting, and evaluation assigned to God as the closing responsibility
words.root_gloss_range: counting, reckoning, evaluation, judgment, sufficiency, and supposition; local noun selects comprehensive divine accounting and judgment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābu}}) lands as the final noun and the second delayed subject. Its {{ar:ح س ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-s-b}}) range brings counting, evaluation, and settlement into the closing word, while local syntax assigns the whole reckoning process to God and pairs it against the Prophet's conveyance. The same-surah thread moves from feared or evil reckoning at 13:18 and 13:21 to divine prerogative here, then forward to swift execution in 13:41.

topics.headline: known reckoning occupies the mirrored slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reckoning is a recognized category placed in the same grammatical slot as conveyance, but under the divine bearer.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, abstract, nominative, and delayed after the fronted upon-Us predicate.

topics.headline: reckoning is evaluation and settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing word means comprehensive accounting and judgment, with sufficiency and settlement coloring it while supposition is not the local sense.
topics.reason: The root range includes supposing and sufficing, but the definite abstract noun in this responsibility clause selects accounting, evaluation, and judgment.

topics.headline: reckoning completes the conveyance pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's system: conveyance is the transmission stage and reckoning is the divine evaluation stage.
topics.reason: The two definite abstract nouns share mirrored syntactic positions and contrasting bearers.

topics.headline: same-surah reckoning narrows to divine prerogative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reckoning is a local surah thread: feared or evil reckoning at 13:18 and 13:21 becomes God's assigned prerogative here.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence supports a structural reckoning thread concentrated near the closing movement.

topics.headline: final word returns uncertainty to accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close away from the Prophet's uncertain future and onto God's accounting, which is then characterized as swift in 13:41.
topics.reason: As the final noun, the word receives closure weight, links back to the record-frame, and bridges forward to the next ayah's swift reckoning at 13:41.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two divine alternatives are followed by reciprocal assignments marked by upon you and upon Us.
baseline_models.mechanism: Showing a promised event or fully taking the messenger changes his witness-state, but neither alternative transfers delivery to God or accounting to the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Causative showing makes a promised portion perceptible while retaining divine control of disclosure.
Taking the soul supplies the alternate endpoint of the messenger's witness-state.
Delivery of the message defines the messenger-facing task.
Counting and settlement define the divine-facing task.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely consoles the messenger that punishment may occur before or after his death.
changed_reading.after: The verse establishes a jurisdictional partition that remains invariant across seeing fulfillment and dying before it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Some, take in full, reach, and account form a sequence of quantity and completion terms.
baseline_models.mechanism: A partial disclosure is set against a complete taking; delivery reaches its assigned endpoint, while accounting gathers the whole. The messenger may receive only a fragment of visible outcome without the promise itself being fragmentary.

activation_trace.role: Partition supplies the explicitly limited share of fulfillment that may become visible.
Completion without deficiency contrasts the messenger's full taking with the shown portion.
Reaching a limit gives the messenger's task its proper endpoint.
Enumeration closes the sequence by gathering what partial sight cannot totalize.

changed_reading.before: Some simply weakens the quantity of punishment the messenger might see.
changed_reading.after: Partial sight and complete settlement are deliberately separated: limited manifestation does not imply incomplete fulfillment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Delivery and account occupy parallel upon-clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both nouns activate sufficiency branches, making the clauses balanced limits: delivery is enough for the messenger's remit, and divine sufficiency completes what lies beyond it.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency constrains delivery to a complete and adequate remit rather than outcome-control.
Sufficiency makes the divine side adequate to everything left outside the messenger's remit.

changed_reading.before: Delivery and reckoning are merely two different jobs.
changed_reading.after: They are counterweighted sufficiencies: each side is adequate to its own assigned scope, with no deficit caused by an unseen outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Promise and taking stand as alternatives before the fixed duty/account clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise can carry an appointed time, while full taking can be arrival at an appointment. Death therefore need not interrupt the promised horizon; it can be the messenger's alternate arrival while delivery and account continue toward their own ends.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time or place turns promise from vague futurity into a bounded convergence.
Arrival at an appointment lets taking function as convergence rather than cancellation.
Reaching an endpoint keeps the messenger's task complete even under the death alternative.

changed_reading.before: Death is the possibility that prevents the messenger from seeing the promise.
changed_reading.after: Death is an alternate convergence within an appointed system, not a failure of either promise or mission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes demanded acceleration and demanded signs with a divinely shown flash that carries fear and hope. The focus some can therefore be a controlled sample, affectively double and not scheduled by its audience.

activation_trace.role: Divine showing anchors the focus as an intentionally disclosed sample.
Hastening supplies the audience's attempt to advance the adverse outcome.
Warning that awakens caution defines the messenger's role without granting spectacle-control.
The repeated causative showing supplies a contextual instance of controlled disclosure.
A visible flash models a bounded manifestation rather than the whole storm or outcome.

structural_cues: 13:6 asks to hasten bad before good; 13:7 asks for a sign; 13:12 repeats showing with fear and hope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demanded acceleration, warning, and a fear-hope flash; I infer that controlled sample -> warning without timetable surrender. A live alternative is that the lightning scene is only a separate natural sign.

changed_reading.before: Some promised punishment may simply happen during the messenger's lifetime.
changed_reading.after: The shown some may be a sovereign warning-sample that can produce fear and hope without satisfying a demand for immediate proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water aimed at a mouth fails to reach it, then hearers divide into responders and nonresponders before bad account is named. Against that sequence, focus delivery is successful message-arrival, not compelled uptake; response passes into the accounting side.

activation_trace.role: Message delivery anchors the remit whose boundary is being sharpened.
Failed arrival at the mouth supplies a concrete contrast between aiming and actually reaching.
Answering versus not answering locates uptake on the hearer's side of the message.
The named account attaches consequence to the response bifurcation.

structural_cues: 13:14 stages an extended hand, water, a mouth, and non-arrival; 13:18 contrasts response and nonresponse before naming the account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed physical reaching, human response, and account; I infer message arrival -> opportunity to respond -> divine settlement. A live alternative is that the water simile has no technical bearing on the later noun delivery.

changed_reading.before: Delivery means speaking the revelation, while conversion remains vaguely outside the messenger's control.
changed_reading.after: Delivery marks the successful endpoint of transmission; uptake is a separate hearer-action whose consequence belongs to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise arrives without breach, respite can precede seizure, and a messenger cannot produce a sign except by permission while every term has a prescribed register. The focus alternatives vary witness and timing, not whether fulfillment remains operative.

activation_trace.role: The appointed promise anchors fulfillment in a bounded horizon.
Promise and appointed term are asserted as an arriving horizon that is not breached.
Extended time supplies delay without cancellation.
Seizure after respite supplies the delayed endpoint.
Permission blocks autonomous sign-production by a messenger.
A fixed extent of time supplies the schedule boundary.
A binding inscription gives each term a governing determination.

structural_cues: 13:31 says the promise comes and is not breached; 13:32 sequences respite then seizure; 13:38 denies autonomous sign-production and pairs every term with a writ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonbreach, delayed seizure, permission, term, and writ; I infer regulated timing -> fulfillment independent of the messenger's lifespan. A live alternative is that these are separate limits with no single schedule mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Whether We show or take you expresses uncertainty about which future will occur.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives express controlled timing: fulfillment is noncontingent, while the messenger's access to its visible phase is contingent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, traces can be effaced or established while a governing book remains with God. This activates some shown as a selected manifestation within changing visible history, not as the total inventory of what is held for account.

activation_trace.role: Partition anchors the distinction between a manifested portion and a larger whole.
Loss of a trace supplies the possibility that an expected visible mark disappears.
Persistence supplies the converse possibility that a trace remains established.
Binding inscription supplies a governing register beyond any single visible trace.

structural_cues: 13:39 juxtaposes effacing and establishing, then locates the mother of the book with God immediately before 13:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutable traces and a held book; I infer visible selection -> only some enters the messenger's history. A live alternative is that 13:39 asserts sovereignty without distinguishing visible and governing registers.

changed_reading.before: Some is only a quantitative fraction of future events.
changed_reading.after: Some may also mark selective inscription into visible history; what is not shown need not be absent from the governing account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment is followed by a garden promised to the guarded, then a faction rejects part of what was sent down. The focus promise can therefore retain both favorable and adverse horizons, while some also echoes selective reception rather than only partial execution of threat.

activation_trace.role: Promise that can open expectation of good or bad anchors the coexistence of outcome horizons.
A favorable promised outcome prevents the promise field from collapsing into threat by default.
Refusal to recognize supplies the hearer's selective rejection.
Partition recurs immediately before the focus as the portion being rejected.

structural_cues: 13:34 names punishment, 13:35 names the promised garden and two final outcomes, and 13:36 names rejection of part.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adverse and favorable outcomes plus partial rejection; I infer a dual promise field -> the focus need not be rendered as threat alone. A live alternative is that the local them narrows the focus exclusively to deniers.

changed_reading.before: What We promise them is only the punishment threatened against opponents.
changed_reading.after: A threat reading remains live, but a broader promise horizon also survives, with shown portions disclosing differentiated outcomes and responses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns seeing into a spatial process: divine coming is registered as loss from boundaries, then irreversible judgment and swift account close the sequence. This gives the focus some a concrete mode of progressive, edgewise manifestation.

activation_trace.role: A portion anchors the limited extent of visible fulfillment.
Perceptual seeing makes the following process an offered visible instance.
Coming supplies directed advance into the visible field.
Loss of part supplies the incremental material change.
The edge locates where partial change first becomes legible.
Judgment converts spatial encroachment into a nonreversible ruling process.
Speed prevents gradual visibility from implying sluggish final settlement.
Account supplies the totalizing closure after partial edge-loss.

structural_cues: 13:41 follows the focus directly and sequences seeing, coming, diminishing from edges, unanswerable judgment, and swift account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible edge-loss sequence followed by judgment and account; I infer edgewise diminution -> an instance of the focus's shown some. A live alternative is that 13:41 offers an independent sign rather than an exemplification.

changed_reading.before: The shown portion is an unspecified event selected from a future list.
changed_reading.after: The portion can appear processually at boundaries: fulfillment becomes visible by incremental edge-loss even while complete account remains swift and irreversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each soul's acquisition supplies the account's object, while sufficient informed witness answers the denial of messengership. The messenger need not see promised outcomes to authenticate either his delivery or the later accounting.

activation_trace.role: Adequate delivery anchors the limited but complete messenger-side remit.
Sufficiency anchors the divine-side completion beyond visible proof.
Acquisition supplies concrete action as material for the account.
Standing over a matter until it is sufficient answers the demand for further authentication.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies validation without requiring witnessed punishment.

structural_cues: 13:42 places what every soul earns under knowledge; 13:43 answers you are not sent with sufficient witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earned action, denial, sufficiency, and informed witness; I infer adequate witness -> mission validity independent of visible fulfillment. A live alternative is that witness answers only the denial and does not reactivate the focus sufficiency branches.

changed_reading.before: God's account is a later task unrelated to whether the messenger sees proof.
changed_reading.after: The account is action-indexed and already adequately witnessed; seeing promised effects is unnecessary both for mission validation and for settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant counted/prepared target supplied for the focus promise; it remains anchored by the explicit promise beside account and by the timed writ in 13:38. Downstream prose should present it as a split-root activation, not as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places promise directly before partial showing and directly across from account.

activation_trace.role: Counting turns the promised field into an enumerable inventory rather than vague futurity.
Preparation makes promised outcomes ready material even before their visible release.
Accounting receives the counted inventory at the far end of the verse.
A binding writ gives the counted-prepared activation a contextual scheduling support.

changed_reading.before: The promise is an undifferentiated future threat from which some may be shown.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, promised outcomes form a counted and prepared inventory: some can be released into sight while the whole remains available to account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant water target for seeing and crosses visual disclosure with the surah's measured water flow; it remains anchored to the focus showing and some. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, never a replacement meaning for the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines causative showing with an explicitly limited portion.

activation_trace.role: Satisfaction of thirst recasts disclosure as receiving enough of an unseen reserve to sustain witness.
Carrying water gives the shown portion a transport mechanism that can feed later conveyance.
Partition limits the draught and prevents the analogy from implying total disclosure.
Delivered water supplies the contextual material flow behind the analogy.
A measure reaching its proper limit constrains how much each channel receives.

changed_reading.before: Showing is only visual access to an event.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, showing some is a measured draught from a larger reserve: enough to sustain and convey witness, never the total promised store.

strongest_changes: Partial manifestation is separated from complete fulfillment through the some/full-taking/reaching/account sequence.
Delivery reaches its endpoint before human response, while response becomes material for account.
Permission, term, writ, respite, and nonbreach make the messenger's witness of fulfillment contingent but fulfillment itself noncontingent.
The immediate sequel renders some processually as visible loss from edges followed by irreversible judgment and swift account.
Sufficient informed witness removes any need for the messenger to see promised effects as proof of mission.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact division of labor opened into several coexisting mechanisms: quantitative partiality versus total settlement, controlled warning-samples, timed fulfillment, mutable visible traces, edgewise encroachment, and sufficient witness. Split targets additionally activated a counted-prepared promise and a measured draught of sight without displacing the primary morphology.
remaining_uncertainties: The local pronoun may narrow the promise to adversaries even though the immediate context preserves both favorable and adverse promised outcomes.
The two-register reading of 13:39 depends on a reader-supplied relation between mutable traces and the held book.
The counted and water-bearing split-root models are associative activations and should not be promoted to lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ب ل غ/B001` is reaching an endpoint. The messenger may see only part of the promise or die, yet delivery is his task; 13:14 showed failed reaching. I infer completion at the assigned transmission boundary, not control of downstream consequence.
2. `ح س ب/B001` is accounting. Balanced `عَلَيْكَ` / `عَلَيْنَا` allocates agency. I infer that reckoning includes correct attribution of responsibility; outcome is not charged to the carrier.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:43 supplied the sufficient witness for the mission, confirming that completed delivery can be vindicated without the messenger controlling outcomes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The promise's visibility and the messenger's lifespan are independent clocks.** `و ع د / B001` is a promise that opens expectation, `و ف ي / B002` is receiving the soul in full as death or sleep, `ب ل غ / B002` is conveying a message, and `ح س ب / B001` is counting and reckoning. The conditional permits either showing only part of the promise or taking the messenger fully, yet leaves his assignment unchanged and places account on the other side. Nearby 13:38 binds signs to permission and terms to books, 13:39 permits erasure and confirmation under a source record, and 13:41 calls the account quick. I assign death the role of ending the observer's local timeline, delivery the role of his invariant task, and account the role of the continuing process beyond that endpoint. The packet supplies the alternatives; I infer truncated observation -/-> truncated promise. The ayah reads as a clean separation of responsibilities and timescales.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:41's “quick account” immediately confirmed that the process continues independently of the messenger's observation window. 13:43's sufficient witness further separated his duty to convey from the evidentiary and accounting authority that validates it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Each self acts under standing oversight, accumulates consequences, and enters a reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guardianship and economic acquisition converge in an administered ledger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Acquisition Entered Into Reckoning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Each self acquires an outcome, which is known, counted, and returned as consequence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: seeking and acquiring benefit (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); causing another to acquire (`quranic:root_001296:B002/m01`); numerical reckoning (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); practical accounting of conduct (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); resulting end of an action (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); knowledge that discloses the act (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `كَسَبَت` (ك س ب) and `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م); 13:40-41 `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب); 13:42 `تَكْسِب` (ك س ب), `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م), and `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Acquisition, disclosure, accounting, count, and consequence create a ledger process. What the self "earns" is both an acquired holding and an entry that matures into an outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority gives a text its binding form, permits alteration at one level, and preserves an encompassing register of terms and outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Linguistic clarity, legal force, scribal alteration, and temporal appointment occupy distinct layers of one record system.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Term Entered in the Record
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A bounded term is written as an enforceable appointment that ends in complete taking of life or account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed temporal limit (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); recorded decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); taking a life in full at its term (`quranic:root_001669:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:38 `أَجَل` (ء ج ل) and `كِتَاب` (ك ت ب); 13:40 `نَعِدُهُم` (و ع د) and `نَتَوَفَّيَنَّك` (و ف ي).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Limit, written decree, appointment, and complete taking form a temporal register. The book gives the term legal stability; fulfillment closes it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 - Commissioned Messenger and Divided Responsibility
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A messenger acts under authorization, delivers what is assigned, and does not absorb the authority's work of reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Permission, commission, delivery, and reckoning resemble a delegated administrative chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Delivery Versus Account
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The messenger conveys the assigned message, while the principal retains demonstration, fulfillment, and reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: conveying a message to its endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`); numerical account (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); taking life or term in full (`quranic:root_001669:B002/m01`); causing an event to be seen (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:40 `نُرِيَنَّك` (ر ء ي), `نَعِدُهُم` (و ع د), `نَتَوَفَّيَنَّك` (و ف ي), `البَلَاغ` (ب ل غ), and `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Showing, promising, fulfilling the term, delivering, and counting are separate operations. The messenger owns transmission; the commissioning authority owns outcome and reckoning.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
concept_gloss.applicability: Duyusal görme ile ona benzetilen içsel kavrayışın birlikte amaçlandığı genel anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle algılama çekirdeğini ve içsel kavrayış uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım yalnızca duyusal algıyı veya doğrudan göz tanıklığını gerektirdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal görmeyi ve doğrudan tanıklığı açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle değil, zihinsel veya içsel bir kavrayışla algılama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göz işlevine benzetilen içsel algılama yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Duyusal görme ve doğrudan göz tanıklığı yönünü yitirir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görmek
yeni ayı görebilmek için dikkatle bakmaya çalıştık

error_profile.preserves: İçsel değerlendirme çağrışımının bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gözle algılama ve doğrudan görme çekirdeğini siler.
error_profile.adds: Bir konu hakkında düşünce veya kanı anlamını öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Zihinsel yargı dalıyla kolayca karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışa uzanabilmesi ve doğrudan tanıklık anlatımlarını kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göz duyusunu, gören organı ve bakışın fiziksel açılışını ayrıca adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da göz yoluyla görsel algılamayı merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algılanan şeyi görme eylemini ve bunun içsel kavrayış uzantısını anlatır; komşu dal ise göz duyusunu ve gözün görür duruma getirilmesini de kendi çekirdeğine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışı ve genel görsel algıyı doğrudan tanıklığın yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüz yüze görme ile kesinlik ve ilk elden tanıklık vurgusunu çekirdeğe yerleştirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi doğrudan gözle görme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kapsamı genel görmeden içsel kavrayışa uzanır; komşu dal doğrudan karşılaşma ve gözle kesin tanıklık sınırında daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi algılamış olmayı ve görmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi anlamak için bakışı sürdürme, sınama ve dikkatle inceleme sürecini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gözün bir nesneye yönelmesini gerektirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algının sonucunu veya gerçekleşmesini anlatır; komşu dal ise algıya ulaşmak için yapılan dikkatli ve süreli bakışı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; göz duyusu, doğrudan tanıklık ve dikkatli bakış en yararlı sınırları verdi, öteki adaylar ya uzak temalıydı ya da bu ayrımları yineledi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.
Bir görüşe ulaşmak için konuyu ağır ağır ve farklı yönleriyle düşünme.
Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konu hakkında zihinsel değerlendirme yapıp görüş veya yargı oluşturma çekirdeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşünme sürecini ve bunun görüş ya da yargı sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir durum hakkında kesin bilgi değil, kanı veya sanı bildirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zihinsel yargı ve kanı oluşturma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Danışma ve uzun düşünme süreçlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkasından değerlendirme veya öneri istenen danışma yapılarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının zihinsel yargısını isteme uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendi görüşünü oluşturması ve bilme değeri dışarıda kalır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bilmek, sanmak veya öyle olduğuna inanmak
düşünüp taşınmak ve bir görüşe varmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kavrama çağrışımının sınırlı bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüş oluşturma, düşünüp taşınma ve danışma sınırlarını siler.
error_profile.adds: Duyusal göz algısını birincil anlam gibi öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Gözle algılama dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Görüş, kanı, bilme, sanma ve danışmayı düşünme sürecinin yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş üzerinde düşünme ve ağırdan değerlendirme sürecini kendi başına merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir konu üzerinde düşünerek değerlendirme yapmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düşünmenin sonucundaki görüşü ve ona bağlı kullanımları kapsar; komşu dal esas olarak düşünme ve değerlendirme sürecini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir görüş veya yargı oluşturup onu benimseme yönünün bulunması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kararsızlık, kuşku ve iki olasılık arasında gidip gelme durumunu merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir konu hakkında zihinsel değerlendirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir yargıya yönelir veya varır; komşu dal yargının kurulmasını engelleyen kuşku ve kararsızlığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her düzeydeki görüşü, kanıyı ve görüş istemeyi kapsayan geniş zihinsel alan.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görüşün olgun, sağlam ve iyice kurulmuş olmasını zorunlu kılan nitelik.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kurulmuş bir zihinsel yargıyı konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görüşün niteliği hakkında güvence vermez; komşu dal yalnızca olgunlaşmış ve sağlamlaştırılmış görüşü anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; düşünüp taşınma, kuşku ve sağlam görüş odak dalın süreç, karşıt sınır ve nitelik ayrımlarını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرأي والظن والعلم والتدبير والتروية والاستشارة في الرأي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس رؤية العين ولا الرؤيا ولا الرياء

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca uyku sırasında görülen düşü adlandırır; uyanık algı ve yorumlama ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal uyku sırasında görülen düş anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılara bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Uyuyan bir kişinin uyku sırasında gördüğü düş veya düş görüntüsüdür. Adın çoğul biçimi de aynı türden birden çok uyku deneyimini bildirir.

facets.statement: Uyku sırasında görülen düş veya görüntü.
Aynı uyku deneyiminin tekil ve çoğul adlandırmaları.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı uyku sırasında görülen düş olarak tanımlar ve tekil adın birden çok düşü bildiren çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Uyuyan kişinin gördüğü tek bir düşü veya genel olarak bu uyku deneyimini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku koşulunu ve görülen düş içeriğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyku sırasında bir görüntü veya olay dizisi yaşama eylemi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku içindeki görsel ya da yaşantısal deneyimi doğal Türkçeyle korur.
Göz önünde beliren bir görüntü düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Uyku dışında sezgi, tasarım veya uyanık görüntü anlamlarını da çağırır.
error_profile.collision: Uyanık görme ve zihinsel kavrayışla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyku sırasında görülen şeyi ve onun çoğul adını yalın biçimde bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Cinsel içerikli uyku deneyimini ve görülmemiş bir düşü gördüğünü ileri sürmeyi de kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: düş ile geniş uyku görüsü alanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal uyuyan kişinin gördüğü düşü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalın düş adıdır; komşu dal aynı çekirdeğe ek olarak özel bir bedensel uyku deneyimini ve gerçekte görülmeyen düşü gördüğünü söyleme durumunu içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyku sırasında görülen düş içeriğinin kendisini adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görülen düşü çözümleyip görünür içeriğinden başka bir anlama aktarma işlemini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı uyku deneyimini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görülen şeydir; komşu dal bu şey üzerinde sonradan yürütülen anlamlandırma ve yorumlama işlemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hoş, sıradan veya korkutucu olabilen her tür uyku düşünü kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uyuyanın üstüne çöken, baskı ve korku veren belirli bir uyku yaşantısını anlatması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal uyku sırasında yaşanan görüntü veya duyumlarla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uyku düşlerinin genel adıdır; komşu dal yalnızca baskı, hareketsizlik ve korkuyla belirlenen özel bir uyku olayını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; geniş düş alanı, düş yorumlama ve karabasan sınırları seçildi, uyku ve sevinçli haber gibi öteki adaylar kavramı doğrudan daraltmadı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس رؤية اليقظة ولا رأي القلب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرؤيا معروفة والجمع رؤى (maqayis)؛ رأيت رؤيا حسنة (ayn)؛ رأى في منامه رؤيا وجمع الرؤيا رؤى (sihah)؛ لا تجمع الرؤيا وتجمع الرؤيا رؤى (tahdhib)؛ الرؤيا ما يرى في المنام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiler veya topluluklar arasında karşılıklı görmeyi, karşılaşmayı ve konutların birbirini görecek biçimde karşı karşıya bulunmasını ortak bir görünürlük ilişkisi altında toplar. Tek taraflı bakış ve başkalarına gösteriş yapma bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karşılıklı görünürlük çekirdektir; kişilerin karşılaşması ile yerlerin karşı karşıya durması ayrı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı görme, birinin görünmek üzere ortaya çıkması ve yerlerin karşı karşıya bulunması kendi yapısal sınırlarıyla korunur.

concept_map.definition: İki kişi, topluluk veya yerin birbirini görebilecek biçimde karşılaşması ya da karşı karşıya bulunmasıdır. Bir kişinin görünmek üzere başkasının karşısına çıkması bunun tek yönlü, yapıya bağlı uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: İki tarafın karşılaşıp birbirini görmesi.
Evlerin veya yerlerin birbirini görecek biçimde karşı karşıya bulunması.
Bir kişinin başkasına görünmek üzere onun karşısına çıkması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılaşan tarafların birbirini görmesini ve yerlerin karşılıklı görünür biçimde hizalanmasını aynı eksende birleştirir; birinin görünmek üzere ortaya çıkması da bu eksene bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişilerin, toplulukların veya yerlerin birbirini görebildiği karşılıklı konum için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılaşma, karşılıklılık ve görünebilirlik koşullarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişi veya topluluğun karşılaşıp karşılıklı olarak birbirini görmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taraflar arasındaki karşılıklı görme olayını korur.
error_profile.loses: Evlerin ve yerlerin karşı karşıya bulunması uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, konut veya başka yerlerin karşılıklı görünür konumunu açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerler arasındaki karşılıklı yönelim ve görünürlük ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişilerin karşılaşarak birbirini görmesi olayını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişi ve toplulukların karşılaşıp birbirini görmesi olayını da kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu yer ve nesnelerin birbirini görecek biçimde dizilişini özellikle merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal nesne veya yerlerin birbirini görebilecek biçimde karşı karşıya olmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal canlı tarafların karşılaşmasını da içerir; komşu dal daha çok yerlerin ve nesnelerin karşılıklı görünür dizilişine bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşı karşıyalığın iki tarafın birbirini görmesi sonucunu özellikle gerektirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüz yüze yönelimi, karşılamayı ve sözlü yüzleşmeyi görünürlük olmasa da kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tarafların yüz yüze veya karşı karşıya konumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda karşılıklı görme belirleyicidir; komşu dalda yönelme ve yüzleşme yeterlidir, görmenin gerçekleşmesi zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki taraf arasında karşılıklı görünürlük veya karşılaşma ilişkisini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin kendini tek yönlü olarak başkasının önüne atması veya ona sataşması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin başkasının görüş alanına çıkmasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çoğunlukla karşılıklı görmeyi anlatır; komşu dal tek taraflı yönelme, kendini sunma veya sataşma eylemini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı; görünür hizalanma, yüz yüze geliş ve tek taraflı karşısına çıkma en keskin ayrımları sundu, kalanlar daha genel karşıtlık ya da uzak tema düzeyinde kaldı.
